definitions.gloss: consonance; a chord whose notes blend harmoniously
definitions.explanation: In music, a combination of notes that sounds settled and agreeable to the ear. It is the technical opposite of {不協和音|ふきょうわおん} (dissonance), and unlike that word it stays inside music theory rather than being used figuratively for human discord.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{協和音|きょうわおん}が{響|ひび}いた。
examples.english: A beautiful consonant chord rang out.

examples.japanese: この{和音|わおん}は{協和音|きょうわおん}に{分類|ぶんるい}される。
examples.english: This chord is classified as a consonance.

examples.japanese: {曲|きょく}の{最後|さいご}は{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}から{協和音|きょうわおん}へと{解決|かいけつ}する。
examples.english: The end of the piece resolves from dissonance into consonance.

notes:
From {協和|きょうわ} (harmony, concord) + {音|おん} (sound).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {協和音|きょうわおん}に{解決|かいけつ}する: to resolve into a consonance
- {完全|かんぜん}{協和音|きょうわおん}: perfect consonance
- {協和音|きょうわおん}{程|てい}{度|ど}: degree of consonance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不協和音|ふきょうわおん}: dissonance — the antonym, and unlike {協和音|きょうわおん} it is also used figuratively for friction between people
- {和音|わおん}: chord — the general term for any combination of notes
